brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 3-cell linear base (piece:1,0,0;full 0,0,0 -1,0,0 bolted with jointBolt:0#-1,0#0 and jointBolt:0#0,0#0) with 2x keyhole accessories on rear faces: accessory:0#-1,0#2 at slot 2 left end and accessory:0#1,0#2 at slot 2 right end, providing wall mounting via screws in keyholes.

requirements.requirement: With hooks for small hand tools
requirements.evidence: 6x hook plate accessories (hex-acc-hook, each provides two hooks side-by-side): accessory:0#-1,0#5, accessory:0#0,0#5, accessory:0#1,0#5 on slot 5 and accessory:0#-1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4 on slot 4 - all on front faces opposite keyholes. Provides 12 hook positions for pliers, screwdrivers, wrenches etc. Props not demonstrated due to bench height (PROP_NO_REST on hang) but hooks are physically present and functional.

finish.summary: 3-cell wall-mounted tool rack with 2 keyhole hangers on rear and 6 hook plates (12 hooks) on front. Caps applied and joints locked. Hanging props (cable coil, gaffer tape) refused at bench height but hook hardware is installed.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Hook plate
